page_title: DAR 0-3 DOR | Darmstadt v Dortmund 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Dortmund quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+4' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the roof of the net lacks power and Marcel Schuhen easily makes the save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+2' 0 - 3 Marcel Sabitzer is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bar to make the score 0:3.
90' Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) receives a yellow card.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Niklas Sule comes onto the pitch because Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
88' Substitution. Donyell Malen makes way for Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luca Pfeiffer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt).
87' Here's the change. Tobias Kempe leaves the pitch and Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) comes on as a substitute.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tim Skarke leaves the pitch and Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) comes on.
81' Here is a change. Niclas Fullkrug is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund).
80' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.

65' The linesman points to the corner flag, Darmstadt are going to take it.

45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

45' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

39' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) blows a golden chance from inside the box, volleying the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a miss!
35' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

30' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.

11' Dortmund are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) will take the free kick.
9' Dangerous play by Salih Ozcan (Dortmund). Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) and Tim Skarke combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
7' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
5' A crossfield pass from Emir Karic (Darmstadt) fails to find any of his teammates.
3' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
3' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) jumps into a tackle and Deniz Aytekin signals a foul.
